notes.title: PC Build 0.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
Devbuild 0.0.6

Hello again Survivors! I'd like to let everyone know that this build is our "First Official Build" of Battle for It All. We recently have opened our doors and hired some new recruitment. We now have an Animator, 2 UE4 Developers, and other staff working around the clock for you guys!

PLEASE NOTE: This Build is only playable by Developers at this time. More info will occur soon.


Matt

So far in this build I've been handling the design for the map, currently you'll be seeing a completely different thing in the build as it's our new "test map" but here are some screenshots of the progress I've done over the past few weeks.



Couchman City

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/2704948397bf1194a999bb4b73af96ca9de213ad.png


Toadfrog Park

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/0b6d18667e9952aaabc648095f14eb7b557a0673.png



Lobby Menu

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/aa07c760d2204182463846e706aad2e64347ff2e.png





Jonathan

For this build, i've worked mainly on the UI for the Menu and the HUD and i also worked on the Steam integration

Menu UI

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/7bc862e86d4484d801ab3b0707ec2b9270b64638.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/7e714ec8fa51fc9256fefcdd189c8612d22daed1.jpg

Steam Integration

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/426ab9736310c8bb1c91bc86dc4f050031b4eb4f.jpg


In-Game HUD

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/8a52fa65d74974d0843b63f68d23f08b07d70830.png




Hannes


Mainly I have introduced a new ADS system (Aim Down Sights) and scopes that you can attach on the weapon. Otherwise I completed even smaller tasks.

ADS & Scopes

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/386b45191eefae4e546cd9a1ea895263cb7615c4.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032269/b88b66e484dea64c57c46a95ee135e776bb9801e.png


Current Progress / Patch Notes:

    Map Progress
    Main Menu UI
    In-Game UI
    Inventory Progress
    Weapon Signs Added
    New Lighting System Progress
    New Vehicle System Progress
    Couchman City Progress
    Industrial Progress
    New Landscape Progress
    Military Base Progress
    Steam SDK Integration
    Removed VR Support (will look into further bugs)
    Partial Controller Support
    Company Intro Added
